description: Cross-harness matrix suite for the domain-expert-core plugin's meta/procedural skills (update-plugin, ultimate-tech-stack, plugin-builder, skill-builder). These are pipeline, workflow, and marketplace-mechanics skills rather than technology skills, so prompts probe documented rules, budgets, phase structures, and defaults instead of external technical facts. Prompts are deliberately neutral so the no-skill arm is not tipped off. Every expected answer is traceable to cited content shipped in the four skills on 2026-08-08. knowledge: 'recent' = fact a bare model plausibly lacks (post-cutoff or niche); 'stable' = long-standing fact a strong bare model may know.

tasks.prompt: In the domain-expert Claude Code marketplace, how many plugins total are there when you count every IT domain plugin plus domain-expert-core? Answer concisely with the number.
tasks.notes: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/update-plugin/SKILL.md - Look for the @domain-expert suffix to see which of the 19 plugins (18 domains + domain-expert-core) the user has

tasks.prompt: How many cross-domain task agents does the domain-expert-core plugin bundle? Answer concisely with the number.
tasks.notes: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/update-plugin/SKILL.md - domain-expert-core, which holds the six cross-domain task agents (architecture-consultant, troubleshooting-agent, migration-expert, iac-consultant, data-expert, security-expert) and this skill

tasks.prompt: After a Claude Code plugin update command succeeds, does the change apply to the session that is currently running, or only starting from the next session? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/update-plugin/SKILL.md - Plugin updates take effect on the next Claude Code session. The currently running session keeps the version it started with.

tasks.prompt: In the domain-expert marketplace's security-first tech stack scoring model, what percentage weight is assigned to security architecture and secure defaults when comparing candidate technologies that already passed the security gate? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/ultimate-tech-stack/SKILL.md scoring table - Security architecture and secure defaults | 30%

tasks.prompt: Between Terraform and OpenTofu, which one does the domain-expert marketplace's security-first tech stack guidance recommend adopting as the open-source infrastructure-as-code default? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/ultimate-tech-stack/SKILL.md Replacements table - Terraform: Do not adopt as an open-source default, BSL-licensed; use OpenTofu

tasks.prompt: According to the domain-expert marketplace's security-first tech stack defaults, which web application framework is the starting default for a conventional business application, before FastAPI or Next.js is earned by a specific requirement? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/ultimate-tech-stack/SKILL.md Defaults at a Glance table - Application | Supported Django LTS + server-rendered templates/htmx

tasks.prompt: How many mandatory checkpoints requiring a direct user answer does the plugin-builder pipeline's interview-first contract call for? Answer concisely with the number.
tasks.notes: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/plugin-builder/SKILL.md - Three mandatory checkpoints, each requiring a user answer: (0) the intent interview, (2) architecture sign-off before any file moves, (3) explicit confirmation before destructive migration steps

tasks.prompt: When the plugin-builder pipeline's intent interview uses AskUserQuestion to gather answers, what is the maximum number of questions it should batch into a single call? Answer concisely with the number.
tasks.notes: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/plugin-builder/SKILL.md - Batch questions with AskUserQuestion, up to 4 per call, concrete options plus the built-in free-text escape

tasks.prompt: In plugin-builder's component placement guide, which Claude Code component type should you choose for behavior that must happen every time, deterministically, on a lifecycle event? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/plugin-builder/SKILL.md component table - Behavior that must happen every time, deterministically, on a lifecycle event | Hook (hooks/hooks.json)

tasks.prompt: In the skill-builder pipeline's curation standards, at how many lines does a skill body's length become a hard fail rather than merely above target? Answer concisely with the number.
tasks.notes: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/skill-builder/SKILL.md - Body. 200-500 lines is the target; 1,000 is a hard fail.

tasks.prompt: In the skill-builder pipeline, which model tier does the single curator agent that writes the finished skill run on? Answer concisely.
tasks.notes: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/skill-builder/SKILL.md - the curator runs model: opus (the strongest reasoning model the harness offers)

tasks.prompt: In skill-builder's frontmatter guidance, what character count is treated as the absolute ceiling for a skill's description field, even when overlap disambiguation genuinely demands extra length? Answer concisely with the number.
tasks.notes: plugins/domain-expert-core/skills/skill-builder/SKILL.md - repo median is ~530 characters, p90 ~890. Stay under ~900 unless overlap disambiguation genuinely demands more; treat 1,500 as the ceiling.
